sources.title: https://www.lakestevenswa.gov/DocumentCenter/View/13293/DRAFT_InteriorWorkExempt
sources.supports: Residential Interior Permit Exemptions (approved 12/2022): painting, papering, tiling, carpeting, cabinets, countertops, drywall holes, trim around windows/doors; windows in existing openings (size/operable opening not altered or decreased); repair or replacement of siding; interior doors; clearing drain blocks/leaks; exemption does not authorize code violations; Planning and Community Development 1812 Main St, (425) 622-9400, permits@lakestevenswa.gov

sources.title: https://www.lakestevenswa.gov/DocumentCenter/View/13297/DRAFT_Residential-Inspections-Handout
sources.supports: Permit holder requests inspections; no work beyond each inspection point without approval; unapproved portions not covered or concealed; inspection card and plans on site; electrical permits and inspections via L&I; weather barrier/window flashing inspection after windows installed with flashing and weather barrier complete

sources.title: https://www.lakestevenswa.gov/DocumentCenter/View/15163/Handout_Deck_Tip-Sheet
sources.supports: Deck permit if >=200 sf, >=30 in above grade, attached to dwelling, or serves required exit (2021 IRC w/ WA amendments); all wood PT or naturally decay resistant, treat cuts with end cut solution; fasteners SS/HDG or as required for preservative; design professional when ledger over bay windows, brick, stone, CMU or hot tub

sources.title: https://www.lakestevenswa.gov/DocumentCenter/View/16095/ST_Requirements_Acting-Contractor-4-21-26
sources.supports: Owner-builder form: RCW 18.27 licensed contractor required unless exempt (RCW 18.27.090); owner-builder liability for unlicensed workers' injuries; owner verifies contractor state license and City of Lake Stevens business license

sources.title: https://www.lni.wa.gov/licensing-permits/contractors/hiring-a-contractor/
sources.supports: State hiring guidance: registration, bids, written contract
